title: Remote delivery after a kept-root recovery is uncredited as "the named root moved" though the root did not move
outcome: Remote delivery after a kept-root recovery is uncredited as "the named root moved" though the root did not move
acceptance: After a kept-root recovery or handoff, a remote verification delivery either earns credit under the same rule as verification_record, or the intended difference is documented with its reason; a behavior test shows the chosen result.
